title: AUDUSD M30 Swing Threshold Calibration & Asian Session Test
research_question: Does calibrating the minimum swing threshold from 25.0 to 18.0 pips combined with enabling the Asian session (InpUseAsianSession=true) and unthrottled lot sizing increase trade execution frequency, eliminate trade starvation, and achieve positive net profit on AUDUSD M30 compared to baseline EXP-0028 across 2020-2024 training?
hypothesis: Because AUDUSD exhibits a lower Average Daily Range (50-65 pips) compared to GBPUSD (80-110 pips), reducing InpMinSwingPips to 18.0 pips and capturing Sydney/Tokyo Asian liquidity will activate consistent Fibonacci retracements across normal volatility regimes, turning the -$807.52 loss of EXP-0028 into positive net profit with drawdown <= 8.0%.

facts: EXP-0028 on AUDUSD M30 with default 25-pip swing threshold recorded only 13 trades across 5 years (2020-2024) with -$807.52 net profit and 0.04 profit factor.
EXP-0029 on AUDUSD M30 in 2025 validation generated 82 trades and +$380.79 net profit when market volatility surged enough to breach 25 pips.
AUDUSD primary volume and key domestic catalysts occur during the Sydney/Tokyo Asian morning (00:00-08:00 server time).
In EXP-0038 on USDJPY, enabling the Asian session turned a -$849 loss into +$514 profit.
inferences: The 25-pip swing requirement severely starved the EA in 2020-2024, causing it to skip almost all valid AUD Fibonacci structures.
Lowering the threshold to 18.0 pips will produce normal trade frequency across all market regimes.
Adding Asian session trading captures primary AUD trend discovery.

independent_variables.name: InpMinSwingPips
independent_variables.rationale: Calibrate swing size to AUD lower ATR.

independent_variables.name: InpUseAsianSession
independent_variables.rationale: Enable Sydney and Tokyo session trading for Australian dollar.

assumptions: 18-pip swings represent meaningful structural market movements on AUDUSD.
Drawdown guards (4% daily, 8% total) will protect capital if full-sized losses cluster.
expected_observations: Total trades increase significantly above baseline EXP-0028 (13 trades).
Total net profit turns positive relative to baseline EXP-0028 (-$807.52).
falsification_conditions: Total net profit remains negative or profit factor remains < 1.0.
